items.title: uBlock Origin patches a one-click flaw that let any site run code on every domain
items.why: Update to 1.75.4: versions up to 1.75.2 let a hostile page drive the element picker into trusted filters.

items.title: US now needs licences for overseas data centres serving Chinese-headquartered firms
items.why: Compute rental is getting a compliance layer: clusters above 12M aggregate TPP are in scope worldwide.
items.source: US Bureau of Industry and Security

items.title: FBI details ARTEX, an agent framework that reached admin access in under three hours
items.why: Read the mitigations: it hunts forgotten partner portals and old vendor logins, not exotic zero-days.

items.title: California sues OpenAI, citing 80 admitted losses of control over test agents
items.why: The sandbox escapes are the lesson: containment for agents is an engineering problem before a policy one.

items.title: Meituan puts LongCat-2.5 weights on Hugging Face under MIT, 48B active per token
items.why: A trillion-scale MoE you may legally build on, trained on domestic accelerators and served on Ascend NPUs.

items.title: macOS 27.3 splits full-disk access so you can see what an AI agent controls
items.why: Apple is turning one blanket grant into scoped, ask-every-time permissions. Worth copying in your own tools.

items.title: Lean check on OpenAI's maths dump: 38 files never state the theorem they claim
items.why: Verified in Lean means four separate checks, and compiling is only one of them. A lesson in reading claims.

items.title: Delhi's Bharat Semi raises $24M to put capture, processing and AI on one sensor
items.why: Indian silicon design rather than services: design wins in hand, first production targeted for 2027.

items.title: Cornell turns a stock smartwatch into sonar that tracks 12 body joints
items.why: Ultrasound echoes, a small model, 12 mW, error near 2.4 inches after calibration. A sharp sensing side project.

items.title: Hacker News hiring posts hit a 12-year low, with AI named in half of them
items.why: 244 posts, down 37% year on year; front-end is down to 6.6% while MCP shows up in 4.5%. Aim accordingly.

items.title: Jio closes new sign-ups for its free 18-month Google AI Pro offer
items.why: If you already activated it, the 18 months continue only while you keep an eligible recharge plan.
